name: ElectricityLoadDiagrams20112014
source_format: semicolon-delimited text; first column is timestamp and remaining columns are clients
deepstoch_target_mapping: one selected client column becomes target
notes: The original dataset is not committed to this repository because of its large download size.
The UCI description states that the values are in kW and that kWh requires division by 4.
Time-change days contain documented zero or aggregated intervals and must be preserved or explicitly handled in preprocessing.
